company.name: Notion
company.one_liner: The AI workspace that works for you.

summary.text: Notion grows through a free, self-serve product with a sales path beside it, backed by search at scale. A free plan and "Get Notion free" sit next to "Request a demo". Its site carries about 2,800 template pages, 588 blog posts and 9 comparison pages in 22 languages, and on Google it runs roughly 600-700 ads, many live for four months or more, with separate landing pages for LinkedIn, Meta and YouTube traffic.

channels.read: About 600-700 ads are listed. 11 of the 40 we sampled have run 120+ days, so many ads are kept, not rotated out.
About 2,800 template pages, 588 blog posts and 486 help articles, translated into 21 languages.
A free plan and a self-serve signup button share the first screen with a demo request.
9 Notion-written comparison pages, a Notion vs Airtable landing page, and creator-made "alternative" templates.
Separate LinkedIn landing pages for new and existing customers, updated in August. We did not pull the ads.
A Meta landing page updated in August. We did not pull the ads.
A connections directory and a developer site give integrations and the API their own pages.
Publishes llms.txt and lets OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity and Google AI crawlers in, while blocking Meta and Amazon.

connections.text: From the first screen a visitor can start free or ask for a demo, and the pricing page leads with the free plan.

notable_plays.text: Templates are the SEO engine: about 2,800 indexable template pages, most of them "collection" pages that bundle creator templates for a search term.
Paid landing pages are split by channel and audience: LinkedIn has one page for new customers and another for existing ones, alongside pages for Meta, YouTube and a Notion vs Airtable comparison.
Comparison pages target newer rivals as well as incumbents: there is a Notion vs Granola page beside Notion vs Confluence.
It welcomes AI answer engines: an llms.txt plus open access for ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity crawlers.
The homepage headline is not fixed: two captures on the same day showed different hero lines.

couldnt_see.text: The Meta, LinkedIn and TikTok ads themselves. We found landing pages for LinkedIn and Meta, but did not pull those ad libraries.
Whether ad pixels load after cookie consent.
Social, video, community, reviews, press, referral and hiring.
